assumptions: The dummy card is a standard unsecured card: finance charge 3.75% per month and foreign currency fee 3.5%. Premium, secured and defence variants have different rates in the MITC and are left out.
GST is 18% on every fee, interest and charge. The split into central and state tax depends on the cardholder state; the total is the same.
Annual fee, credit limit, and each EMI plan (amount, rate, tenure, processing fee) are not fixed by the MITC. Set them per dummy card and write them on the statement.
Allow a rounding tolerance of Rs. 1 when comparing expected and actual amounts.

F01.when_it_applies: Total amount due of the previous statement was not paid in full by the due date
F01.expected: Balance x 45% x days / 365 (3.75% per month), counted from the transaction date
F01.flag_if: Interest charged differs from the formula
F01.worked_example: Rs. 6,000 for 38 days: 45% x 38/365 x 6,000 = Rs. 281.10 (MITC example)

F02.when_it_applies: Previous total amount due was paid in full by the due date, no balance carried forward, no cash advance

F03.when_it_applies: A finance charge applies but the computed amount is small
F03.expected: Finance charge is at least Rs. 25 (before tax)
F03.flag_if: Finance charge is above 0 and below Rs. 25

F04.expected: Interest from the withdrawal date until paid; no interest-free period
F04.flag_if: Interest is counted from a date other than the withdrawal date

F05.when_it_applies: Each cash withdrawal at an ATM
F05.expected: Higher of 2.5% of the amount or Rs. 500
F05.flag_if: Fee differs from the formula, or is charged twice for one withdrawal

F06.when_it_applies: Minimum amount due not paid by the due date plus 3 grace days
F06.expected: Fixed slab by outstanding amount due (see Late fee slabs sheet)
F06.flag_if: Fee charged although the minimum due was paid on time, or the wrong slab is used
F06.worked_example: Amount due Rs. 10,500 falls in the 10,000 to 25,000 slab: fee = Rs. 950 (MITC example)

F07.when_it_applies: Minimum amount due missed for two consecutive cycles
F07.expected: Rs. 100 extra per cycle until the minimum due is cleared
F07.flag_if: Charged when fewer than two consecutive cycles were missed, or the amount is not Rs. 100

F08.when_it_applies: Outstanding amount exceeds the credit limit
F08.expected: Higher of 2.5% of the amount over the limit or Rs. 600; once per billing cycle
F08.flag_if: Charged while within the limit, wrong amount, or more than once in a cycle

F09.expected: Higher of 2% of the payment amount or Rs. 500
F09.flag_if: Fee differs, or is charged with no bounced payment on the statement

F10.flag_if: Fee differs from 3.5% of the converted amount

F11.when_it_applies: INR transaction of Rs. 1,000 or more at an international location or overseas-registered merchant
F11.flag_if: Charged on a transaction below Rs. 1,000, on a domestic merchant, or at a different rate

F12.expected: The fee set for the dummy card (MITC range Rs. 0 to Rs. 9,999); waived if annual spend crossed the card's waiver threshold
F12.flag_if: Charged more than once in 12 months, amount differs from the card's fee, or charged although the waiver threshold was met

F13.when_it_applies: Any fee, interest or charge on the statement
F13.expected: 18% of the sum of fees, interest and charges
F13.flag_if: GST differs from 18% of that sum, or GST is charged on purchases
F13.worked_example: Annual fee Rs. 500: GST = Rs. 90 (MITC example)

F14.expected: 100% of GST + 100% of EMI + 100% of fees + 100% of finance charges + over-limit amount + 2% of remaining balance (at least Rs. 200), plus any unpaid minimum due from earlier statements
F14.flag_if: Printed minimum due differs from the formula

F15.expected: Statement date + 20 days (as used in the MITC examples)
F15.flag_if: Due date is earlier than statement date + 20 days

F16.when_it_applies: Utility payments in a billing cycle total more than Rs. 50,000
F16.expected: 1% of the total utility payments in that cycle
F16.flag_if: Charged when the total is Rs. 50,000 or less, or the amount is wrong
F16.worked_example: Utility total Rs. 64,000: fee = Rs. 640 (MITC example)

F17.when_it_applies: Education payment made through a third-party app
F17.flag_if: Fee differs from 1%, or is charged on a payment made directly to the school or college

F18.flag_if: Charged on a load of Rs. 1,000 or less, or the amount is wrong

F19.flag_if: Amount differs, or charged twice for one rent payment

F20.expected: 1% of the transaction amount, plus tax

F21.when_it_applies: Bill paid in cash at a bank branch
F21.flag_if: Amount differs, or charged when no cash payment was made

F22.flag_if: Amount differs, or charged when no cheque payment was made

F23.when_it_applies: Reward points redeemed for physical products, statement credit or physical vouchers
F23.flag_if: Amount differs, or charged with no redemption

F24.flag_if: Amount is outside the range, or charged with no replacement

F25.when_it_applies: An EMI instalment is billed and not paid by the due date
F25.flag_if: Interest on unpaid EMI differs from the formula, or is charged although the EMI was paid
F25.worked_example: Rs. 6,730.03 unpaid for 11 days: Rs. 91.27 (MITC example)

C01.when_it_applies: Same merchant, amount and date appear twice
C01.expected: Same merchant, amount and date appear twice
C01.flag_if: A second identical transaction is charged

C02.when_it_applies: An ongoing EMI should appear every month until its last instalment
C02.expected: An ongoing EMI should appear every month until its last instalment
C02.flag_if: An ongoing EMI is not on this month's statement

C03.when_it_applies: Each EMI should appear once per month
C03.expected: Each EMI should appear once per month
C03.flag_if: The same EMI is charged twice in one month

C04.when_it_applies: EMI amount should match the plan and earlier months
C04.expected: EMI amount should match the plan and earlier months
C04.flag_if: The amount differs from the plan amount

C05.when_it_applies: Instalment number should go up by one each month and stop at the tenure
C05.expected: Instalment number should go up by one each month and stop at the tenure
C05.flag_if: A number is skipped or repeated, or an EMI is charged after the last instalment

C06.when_it_applies: EMI = P x r x (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1), where P is the amount, r the monthly rate, n the tenure
C06.expected: EMI = P x r x (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1), where P is the amount, r the monthly rate, n the tenure
C06.flag_if: EMI on the statement differs from the formula for the stated plan

C07.when_it_applies: A recurring merchant should charge the same as last month
C07.expected: A recurring merchant should charge the same as last month
C07.flag_if: This month's charge is higher than last month's

C08.when_it_applies: A merchant that starts charging every month
C08.expected: A merchant that starts charging every month
C08.flag_if: A new subscription appears that was not in earlier months

C09.when_it_applies: A refund or reversal that the earlier statements lead us to expect
C09.expected: A refund or reversal that the earlier statements lead us to expect
C09.flag_if: The refund is not on the statement

C10.when_it_applies: Opening balance + purchases + fees + interest + GST - payments - refunds
C10.expected: Opening balance + purchases + fees + interest + GST - payments - refunds
C10.flag_if: The result does not equal the closing balance

C11.when_it_applies: Every fee should have a matching event on the statement
C11.expected: Every fee should have a matching event on the statement
C11.flag_if: A fee appears with nothing that triggers it

C12.flag_if: A large charge from a merchant never seen before

N01.looks_wrong: Payment made up to 3 days after the due date, with no late fee
N01.why_allowed: A 3-day grace period applies when nothing is overdue from earlier cycles

N02.looks_wrong: A purchase is refunded but the foreign currency fee is not
N02.why_allowed: Foreign currency and currency conversion fees are not reversed on refunds

N03.looks_wrong: A transaction is reversed but the over-limit fee stays
N03.why_allowed: The over-limit fee is not reversed on reversal, cancellation or refund

N04.looks_wrong: A rent payment is refunded but the Rs. 199 fee stays
N04.why_allowed: The rent processing fee is not reversed

N05.looks_wrong: No payment made, yet no late fee
N05.why_allowed: A refund credited before the due date for an earlier-cycle purchase counts as payment if it covers the minimum due

N06.looks_wrong: Interest charged in a month where the full bill was paid
N06.why_allowed: If an earlier balance was carried forward, interest runs on it until the payment date

N07.looks_wrong: Interest charged on new purchases straight away
N07.why_allowed: The interest-free period is suspended while any earlier balance is outstanding
